name: nginx-multisite
description: Provides Nginx hosting for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including static site roots, redirects, security headers, rate limiting, hardened TLS, Fail2ban, UFW, sysctl settings, and SSH hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis password authentication, service enablement, log directory setup, and post-configuration adjustments.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application, creates its virtual environment and database, writes environment configuration, and manages its Uvicorn systemd service.
